Name: Inushi, Greater
Source: Lyres Guide to Risk and Reward
Information:
Inushi, wolf yokai, manifest in response to the desires of those who prey upon others. The thrill of the hunt a serial killer experiences, or the misery of those preyed upon by a miser they owe their livelihood to may cause wolf yokai to appear. Once they appear they go about hunting wildlife and mortals who stray too far from their communities. They are drawn to those who are victimized already and are known to eat their way up the food chain until they eventually reach the source of the misery and subjugation that birthed them. When they finally consume the predator who brought them into being they move on, searching for more victims.

***Control Over Wolves.*** Inushi can exert supernatural control over regular wolves, causing them to recognize them as their pack leader. Inushi often incorporate regular wolves into their packs to help them hunt, letting them feed on meat that is not soaked in misery and contempt.

***Greater Inushi.*** Inushi who live long enough evolve into much larger iterations of their predecessors, taking on a phantom-like appearance with wisping fur and bone-like spikes erupting from their joints and spines.

Stat Blocks.title: Inushi, Greater
languages: understands Sylvan and Elvish but doesn’t speak

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The yokai makes two attacks: once each with its Bite and Claws. It can then use its Weary Eye if it is available. If it scores a critical hit on any of its weapon attacks it deals an extra 2d10 damage.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (3d10 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Weary Eye (Recharge 4-6)
actions.description: Three creatures the yokai can see within 30 feet of them are overcome with resentment and emotional weight. The targets must make a DC 16 Charisma saving throw. On a failed save they are so overcome with negativity they cannot bring themselves to fight properly. The affected creature becomes sluggish until the end of the yokai’s next turn.

reactions.name: Blood Frenzy
reactions.description: When a creature is reduced to 0 hit points within 30 feet of the yokai, it moves up to half its movement speed and makes a weapon attack against a creature within range.
